// diagnostic

E1344

CLI command `{command}` collides with another command or root flag

What

CLI command `{command}` collides with another command or root flag

Why

A program struct has one command namespace and one root flag namespace; a word cannot name both.

Fix

rename the command or root field so every command word is unique

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1344: tests/ui/cli_program_command_collision.stderr.

Error [E0105]: method `collide` can't share a name with a field on `Commands`
  --> tests/ui/cli_program_command_collision.jet:4:8
    |
  4 |     fn collide(self) {}
    |        ^^^^^^^
 Why: a type's methods and fields must have different names
 Fix: rename the method or the field
